author: Second Wind
description:
On this week’s Semi-Ramblomatic, someone in the comments told Yahtzee that he's too jaded and just doesn't know how to have fun anymore. Is it true? Is it possible to be bad at having fun? What's the actual point of a criticism if anyone can enjoy anything? And what does Donald Pleasance have to do with any of this?
Turns out, quite a lot.
